SSP.hidden_asset: ATSC 3.0 broadcast spectrum (~0.8-1.3bn MHz-pops via ION); flexible-use / datacasting (EdgeBeam 25%); potential lease/sale to carriers or SpaceX/Starlink
SSP.credit_agreement_feature: April 2026 credit agreement anticipates sale of spectrum usage rights and broadcast licences; after a small threshold, substantially 100% of net cash disposal proceeds are subject to MANDATORY term-loan repayment (70/30 B-2/B-3), up to $50m/yr permitted reinvestment. Deleveraging mechanically transfers value from lenders to the small common-equity stub.
counter_risks: FCC owns the rulebook -- no unilateral conversion to 5G/satellite
opportunity cost: profitable EdgeBeam lease raises the cost of selling
